key_claims: Stage 1 was 197km from Brest to Landerneau with four Category 4 climbs and two Category 3 climbs, including a 3km climb at 5.6% with sections reaching 14%
A spectator holding a cardboard cutout brought down Tony Martin, causing a mass crash that resulted in a DSM rider abandoning the Tour on day one
Julian Alaphilippe won the stage and took the Yellow Jersey; he could potentially go deep into the race despite not being a traditional GC contender
Quickstep controlled the final climb by riding aggressively at 5.6% gradient sections reaching 14% pace, catching Mathieu van der Poel and others off guard
Superman López and Guillain-Martin both lost 1 minute 15 seconds on stage one, demonstrating the brutal nature of the opening stage crashes
specific_numbers: 1 minute 15 seconds time loss for López and Martin
